title: Northern grid: one line trip, two futures
description: A winter weekday peak: Nordland's 420 kV corridor (Salten – Svartisen – Rana – Nedre Røssåga) carries about 390 MW of northern hydropower south through Svartisen – Rana. Statnett runs the 132 kV network under Svartisen as radials, with the tie into Sjona switching station open, so that a 420 kV outage pushes no transit through it; in this exercise that tie, Smibelg – Sjona 132 kV, has been left closed after switching, so the Helgeland 132 kV network runs in parallel with the corridor. A few 132 kV lines elsewhere in Norway already run above their ratings and hold overload alarms, but Helgeland's are lightly loaded. The grid is not N-1 secure there: an outage of Svartisen – Rana 420 kV would push its flow onto the parallel Helgeland 132 kV network, loading Smibelg – Sjona and its neighbours far beyond the 150 % at which their instantaneous protection trips them. Ten minutes in, Svartisen – Rana trips. Find the weakness with N-1 screening, test remedial actions on a private copy of the solved grid, apply the one that works and verify it before the trip. Without preparation, protection splits the 132 kV network between Svartisen and Sjona and load is lost. There are no weather-driven faults.
objectives: Screen every branch outage (contingency.screen, all-branches). The base case already holds a few overloaded 132 kV lines in other regions, so look for outages that push branches over their ratings; identify the one that hits the Helgeland 132 kV network hardest.

Evaluate candidate remedial actions with remedial-actions.evaluate (redispatch, load shedding, opening or closing branches) and choose one after which that outage no longer pushes any Helgeland branch over its rating, without islanding load or adding base-case overloads.
Apply the chosen action with its command and confirm with a fresh screening that the outage no longer overloads the Helgeland network.
When Svartisen – Rana trips at ten minutes, verify that no branch trips and that all load is still served.

cues.title: Sjona tie left closed after switching

guidance.title: A corridor contingency is scheduled at ten minutes
guidance.message: Use Guide to compare two futures. Copy this Run and verify the distinct identity before changing it. In the copy, turn on Grid operations in View to inspect a remedy such as opening Smibelg – Sjona. Review and confirm the actual operation. Advance both Runs to the same exact simulation time for comparison.

guidance.title: Inspect the contingency outcome
guidance.message: The scheduled Svartisen – Rana trip has been attempted. Compare actual topology, affected load, branch trips and observation times in the original and remedied Runs. The default model predicts a different cascade when Smibelg – Sjona is open; verify the result and any partial cue failure rather than assuming that prediction occurred.

guide.title: Compare two corridor futures
guide.description: A guided what-if exercise. Keep the unremedied and remedied Runs separate and compare the same simulation time.

steps.title: Read the starting corridor
steps.instruction: Open Grid operations and inspect the Nordland corridor, its flows and current alarms. The scripted contingency is at ten minutes. Do not treat an authored prediction as an observed cascade.

steps.title: Create an independent copy
steps.instruction: Use the Run copy control, name the copy Remedied, and verify its distinct Run identity and checkpoint time before changing it. Keep this original as Unremedied. Continue records acknowledgement; it does not certify that a copy exists.

steps.title: Ask the Assistant
steps.instruction: In the remedied copy, ask the Assistant for an evidence-based proposal. Review the exact Run and operation targets before authorising changes. A no-provider route is manual Grid inspection; Skip this optional answer task.

action.text: Inspect this Run and evaluate a preventive remedy for the Nordland corridor contingency. Describe evidence and proposed actions before making changes.

steps.title: Apply only the reviewed remedy
steps.instruction: In the remedied Run use supported grid controls after reviewing their effects. Read back the resulting topology and flow. Keep the original unchanged. The guide never applies a remedy from an acknowledgement.

steps.title: Advance the original to ten minutes
steps.instruction: Advance this unremedied Run to exactly ten minutes. Advance the remedied copy to the same exact target separately; do not use elapsed wall time to compare them.

steps.title: Compare actual outcomes
steps.instruction: Compare affected load, branch trips, topology, frequency and timestamps in both Runs. Inspect the cue outcome if the scripted command failed or was uncertain. Record what actually differed and what remains unknown; Continue is an explanation checkpoint, not a claim that the remedy was successful.

steps.title: Continue exploring
steps.instruction: This guide is finished. The same Run remains available. Pause or stop guidance whenever you wish; those controls do not pause the shared simulation. Copy the Run before trying a different intervention. Acknowledgements record your choice to continue, not a qualification.
